name: Import from Gitea
description: Clones a Gitea repo (scripts/ + conf/runners/ layout) and imports its scripts/runners into this instance. Dry-run unless 'apply' is checked.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Gitea access token (only needed for private repos)

parameters.name: apply
parameters.description: Actually copy files (otherwise dry-run only, listing what would be imported)
